blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine Health Insurance Corporation (PhilHealth) on Tuesday warned the public against individuals impersonating its Chief Executive Officer, Beverly Lorraine Ho, to solicit money and conduct unauthorized transactions. In an advisory, PhilHealth said that social media posts, emails, or messages requesting money or donations in the name of the agency or its officials are “fraudulent and part of an illegal scam.” READ: PhilHealth chief: Working primary care system key to expanding benefits “PhilHealth strictly clarifies that neither Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho nor any official or employee of PhilHealth is authorized to solicit funds, donations, or personal bank transfers […]... Keep on reading: PhilHealth warns public against scammers impersonating CEO for money
